notes.title: 【TSUGUNOHI×Inugami Korone】"Evil God Korone" was released.
notes.content:
Tsugunohi, a horror game by ImCyan which VAKA, inc. has assisted to release on game magazines and Steam. This work, which has attracted a lot of attention on YouTube and Twitter every time it is announced, has now achieved a dream collaboration with popular VTuber Inugami Korone.

Inugami Korone has done many horror games Let's Play, and will appear as ""Evil God Korone"" in the daily life invasion horror game ""Tsugunohi"". It was released on Steam from 12:00 on November 8, 2021.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1748610/

This collaboration has already revealed on October 25, 2021, and on the evening of that day, the word Tsugunohi became number 1 trending topic on Twitter. Furthermore, from 22:00 on October 31, 2021, an early live streaming entitled ""Inugami Korone will play a part in the game's Let's Play"" on ""Korone Ch. 戌神ころね"" Youtube channel has been a hot topic even before its release with more than 30,000 Average CCU.
▶ Inugami Korone's live streaming URL: https://youtu.be/6HqfP9uc-sA


【 STORY】
On his way home from school, a male student who was living an ordinary life, sees a sign related to Inugami Korone.
After he muttered "something" in front of the sign, his daily life begins to change and ......
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/93f287f3f37c733c70c21ac941724fde071f5991.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/45d5d542c72e78104ad84fa283ad0e66a2605f5a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/a297316a956fe283bab22ab139192473392d5ee7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/39873c02aff27753cfb05316ac302248c115835e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/7fea26c26875161339da022fcfb286bfa9bd7504.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/1160f75d35de38d6a1f3ee59d066a7462790abbc.png[/img][/url]

【PROFILE】
■The Tsugunohi series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has developed a number of different horror titles. One of his most famous work is the Tsugunohi series. The first episode of the series became a hot topic on the Internet in 2012 as being "super scary." In the summer of 2018, "Tsugunohi -a closed future-" became very popular, especially among game live streamers on YouTube. The popularity of the Tsugunohi series led overseas fans to translate it into Chinese and Korean.
On August 13, 2021, the game was finally released on Steam. The Steam version includes the previous seven titles (The first three episodes of Tsugunohi are remastered versions with cleaner images and enhanced horror effects. ) as well as two new original titles, "Tsugunohi -The Ethereal Railroad Crossing-" and "Tsugunohi -Ai’s Silent Cries-" (a collaboration with a virtual celebrity Kizuna Ai).
In each game, the only control method is to move the main character to the left, so even those who are not good at games can play. Enjoy the gradual transformation of everyday life into something disturbing and terrifying.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/7d3ce11bc78493121791f0ef928a626dd570c670.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/a29e362999105b0a6bc2cd938b5c543050d5b92a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322300/

■Inugami Korone
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/3a493989797c29e79407da1afd2b2ae3616a2913.png[/img]
Ⓒ 2016 COVER Corp.
A dog in a city's bakery. I play games in my spare time while look after the store.
Korone is a virtual celebrity who started her career as a member of the VTuber group Hololive in April 2019. She belongs to Hololive GAMERS, a unit that mainly focuses on game live streaming. As of November 2021, the number of subscribers of her YouTube channel has surpassed 1.7 million.
■ Illustrator：フカヒレ（@fuka_hire）
■ YouTube：https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChAnqc_AY5_I3Px5dig3X1Q 
■ Twitter：https://twitter.com/inugamikorone

■ImCyan
Game creator. They started making indie games during their school days. In 2005, ""Lost Maria-The Nameless Flower-"" won the gold medal at the Tech Win Contest Park.
In December 2012, ""The daily life invasion horror game Tsugunohi"" was announced and attracted a lot of attention with its simple yet innovative style. Since then, they have produced various styles of games for the Tsugunohi series. His  style of transforming the gloomy ""damp"" ambiance that peculiar to Japan into a horror expression based on their aesthetics has been highly praised.
In recent years, ImCyan has been actively experimenting with Gothic horror and collaboration with VTuber, evolving their unique view of the world further. A package of their past works has been released on Steam, and it has gained even more attention, becoming very popular in the live game streaming.
■ Twitter：https://twitter.com/imcyan00aeef"

notes.title: 【Tsugunohi×Inugami Korone】"Evil God Korone" Release on November 8
notes.content:
An unexpected collaboration between Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades your daily life, and Inugami Korone, a VTuber (Virtual YouTuber)  from the VTuber group hololive.

"Evil God Korone"
Release on November 8 , 12:00(JST)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1748610/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/d631c95d479687c7a6bd11794f8e6868ff405cec.png[/img]
PV▶https://youtu.be/OsKsferCCjU

The game play is just like regular Tsugunohi. Every day, you proceed to the left, passing the same places as fear begins to assail you. Will you be able to endure the horrific occurrences that intensify with each passing day?

Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. 

Now the time has come for you to chop your finger and give it to her.

※This collaboration is part of the Inugami Korone Birthday Project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41401610/93f287f3f37c733c70c21ac941724fde071f5991.png[/img]
STORY
On his way home from school, a male student who was living an ordinary life, sees a sign related to Inugami Korone.
After he muttered "something" in front of the sign, his daily life begins to change and ......

PROFILE
■The Tsugunohi series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has developed a number of different horror titles. One of his most famous work is the Tsugunohi series. The first episode of the series became a hot topic on the Internet in 2012 as being "super scary." In the summer of 2018, "Tsugunohi -a closed future-" became very popular, especially among game live streamers on YouTube. The popularity of the Tsugunohi series led overseas fans to translate it into Chinese and Korean, and in 2015, it was made into a movie as Shishu-Tsugunohiitan-.
